body:
Root reads the final report now and independently reproduces comparison6bff1591a4b12905a3b66d9892d519d14ff3096fca209ae64d57c1119607112d exactly. All53 raw/archive members also verify. Close this bounded diagnostic: both pass, warm fills23.432%/20.971% and primary-wall0.762267/0.786567; callback observation alone is insufficient. Preserve A's two one-peripheral-cycle late completions, B's absent callback coverage, ordered/footprint/host-drift limits and actual boost1/Tctl observations without thermal attribution. No quality fix or publication acceptance.

For continued owner work, prepare only a concise source-only proposal selecting the smallest next discriminator between shared trace overhead and primary/wall production pace. Prefer existing aggregate counters/guest duration over another broad instrumentation stream. Define the observation lost if tracing is removed, how comparable demand and progress remain measurable, exact preserved inputs and first-failure/teardown bounds. No queue/rate/extraction/firmware/pacing/power repair or additional device/emulator run is selected. This authorizes the plan only, not implementation/build/new lease. Root will review it while remaining human gates are coordinated; preserve all existing profiles/raw/source.
